business_summary: LS THiRA-UTECH Co., Ltd. operates as a smart factory and smart logistics specialized solution provider in South Korea. It offers THiRA Planner, a solution that establishes production plans; THiRA Scheduler, a work planning solution; THiRA SCP, a supply plan solution; THiRA DCP, a solution for demand planning, forecast consensus, and sales and operation; THiRA Optimizer algorithum; THiRA MES, a production control solution; THiRA EIS, an equipment communication; THiRA SECS-GEM standard protocol; and THiRA MCS, a logistic control. The company also provides THiRAbot, a smart logistics robot solution; THiRA MOM, an integrated manufacturing management system for small and mid-sized manufacturing operation; THiRA Analytics, an abnormality detection; THiRA SPC, a manufacturing analysis solution; and THiRA FMCS, an integrated monitoring platform for enhance user experience. The company was formerly known as THiRA-UTECH CO., LTD. and changed its name to LS THiRA-UTECH Co., Ltd. in April 2025. The company was founded in 2006 and is headquartered in Seoul, South Korea.
business_summary_ko: LS티라유텍(주)는 대한민국의 스마트팩토리, 스마트물류 전문 솔루션 제공업체입니다. 생산계획 수립 솔루션인 THiRA Planner를 제공합니다. 업무 계획 솔루션 THiRA Scheduler; 공급계획 솔루션 THiRA SCP; 수요기획, 예측합의, 판매 및 운영을 위한 솔루션 THiRA DCP; THiRA 최적화 알고리즘; 생산관리 솔루션 티라메스(THiRA MES) 장비통신 THiRA EIS; THiRA SECS-GEM 표준 프로토콜; 및 물류 제어 장치인 THiRA MCS. 스마트 물류 로봇 솔루션인 티라봇(THiRAbot)도 제공하고 있다. 중소제조업을 위한 통합제조관리시스템 THiRA MOM; 이상 탐지 기능인 THiRA Analytics; 제조분석 솔루션 THiRA SPC; 사용자 경험 향상을 위한 통합 모니터링 플랫폼 THiRA FMCS. 회사의 이전 명칭은 THiRA-UTECH CO., LTD입니다. 2025년 4월 사명을 LS티라유텍주식회사로 변경했습니다. 이 회사는 2006년에 설립되었으며 대한민국 서울에 본사를 두고 있습니다.
